**Dispatch — `domain:ui` execution seat @ objectui, round 32.**

Claim: session `session_011SfZeFWrhGLHmfq61xbz4q`, branch `claude/issue-6335-starred-apps-nav-exclusion`. Assigned by the PM.

---

## 1. The body's stop-sign is stale — triage already ruled

The card ends with *"the choice touches a published component's contract, so it wants a maintainer call rather than a drive-by."* That was right when it was written, and triage answered it. **Option 2 is ruled**, quoted:

> Ruled option **2** — enforce the documented exclusion (filter `nav` out of `StarredApps`): the provider already declares nav items "Excluded from Home/Starred", so filtering is declared-equals-enforced restoration, it makes the missing locale key correct by construction, and it avoids both option 1's contradiction (legitimising a kind the provider excludes, ×10 locale packs) and option 3's cost (a published-type union split for a key with no measured reachability). This is invariant restoration, below the escalation bar; veto window via the round report. **Fork clause: if the dev finds a host measurably relying on `StarredApps` rendering `nav` items, stop and report** — that would make it a published-behaviour change and a decision-box question. **Pin the exclusion with a test handing a `nav` item in.**

⛔ Do not implement option 1 or option 3. ⛔ Do not add a `nav` key to any locale pack.

## 2. Census on `origin/main` — verify independently, your reading wins

All four of the card's load-bearing facts reproduce:

- **`StarredApps.tsx` filters nothing by type.** It maps `items` straight through, leaning on `TYPE_ICONS[item.type] || Database` and `TYPE_TONES[item.type] || TYPE_TONES.object` at `:55`/`:56`, and resolves the label via `recentItemTypeLabel(t, item.type)` at `:61`.
- **The exclusion is documented** at `FavoritesProvider.tsx:53` — *"Excluded from Home/Starred and …"*.
- **`nav` really is absent.** `en.ts:2543` declares `itemType` with exactly six keys — `object`, `dashboard`, `page`, `report`, `record`, `metadata`. No `nav`.
- **Ten locale packs** carry `itemType`, confirming option 1's ×10 cost.

⭐ **One thing I measured that the card does not mention.** `StarredApps.tsx:27` carries the comment *"Per-type icon so the four kinds (object / record / dashboard / page) are …"* — but `FavoriteItem['type']` is a **six**-member union (`object | dashboard | page | report | record | nav`). The comment understates by two: `report` and `nav`. It is prose in the exact file you are editing, describing the exact union you are filtering, so correcting it is in scope and worth doing in the same hunk. **This is my reading, not a settled fact — check it and tell me if I am wrong.** (A finding I added to a dispatch order earlier today turned out to be a false positive, and the dev saying so explicitly is the only reason I learned it.)

## 3. The fork clause is real

Before filtering, check whether any host measurably relies on `StarredApps` rendering `nav` items. `StarredApps` is a **public export** from `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/index.ts`, so the composing host supplies the items and the in-repo answer is not the whole answer. If you find such reliance, **stop and report** — that turns this into a published-behaviour change and a decision-box question, not a filter.

As with the other published-export card this round: *"no in-repo caller"* and *"unreachable"* are different findings. Say which one you measured.

## 4. Acceptance

Pin the exclusion with a test that **hands a `nav` item in** and asserts it does not render — triage asked for this by name. A filter with no test that exercises the excluded kind is indistinguishable from no filter.

## 5. Scope

`packages/app-shell/src/console/home/StarredApps.tsx`, its test, a changeset. ⛔ No locale pack edits. ⛔ No change to `FavoriteItem` / `RecentItem` union types — that is option 3, explicitly not ruled. ⛔ Do not touch `recentItemTypeLabel`, whose `string` parameter is deliberate (#6165 made it so precisely because the two unions differ).

Shadow check run before this order: #6507 is in flight in `packages/app-shell/src/console/` but lands in `ConsoleShell.tsx` and `AppContent.tsx` — different files, no overlap with `console/home/`.

**Post-merge verification on `main` (`domain:ui` seat, session `session_011SfZeFWrhGLHmfq61xbz4q`).** PR #6566 landed as `2eb8caede`.

**1. Both halves of the exclusion are on `main`.** `:55` filters (`items.filter((item) => item.type !== 'nav')`), `:57` guards the empty state on the **post-filter** length, `:70` maps the filtered list. The guard is the half most easily missed — filtering the map alone would leave an all-nav list rendering an empty Starred section with a heading.

**2. The comment correction landed** — `:27` now reads "four of the six `FavoriteItem['type']` kinds", and `:30` explains `nav` is the sixth and never reaches the lookup because it is filtered above. That last clause is what keeps the comment true as the code moves around it.

**3. The pin is on `main` with all three cases**, including the control: *"a non-nav kind with no dedicated icon (report) still renders."* Without it, "nav does not render" is equally satisfied by a filter that drops anything lacking a `TYPE_ICONS` entry — which would have silently hidden `report` favourites too.

**4. The deliberate non-changes survived.** No `nav` key in `en.ts`'s `itemType` block (**0**, against a positive control of **6** keys present), and the `FavoriteItem` / `RecentItem` unions are untouched. Those were options 1 and 3 — the ones triage ruled *against* — so their absence is the evidence that option 2 was implemented rather than approximated.

⭐ Recorded for the lane: what made this card safe was not the reachability census but a **structural precedent** — `AppSidebar.tsx:647`/`:655` and `UnifiedSidebar.tsx:592`/`:600` already guard with `some(f => f.type !== 'nav')` and map over `filter(...)`. This is the third surface adopting a shape two siblings already had, which answers "is this a published-behaviour change?" more directly than "no in-repo caller" can. When a card's remedy has a sibling implementation in the same repo, that comparison is worth finding before the census is finished.

**Veto window note:** triage routed this ruling's veto through the round report, where it was surfaced. It has now landed; if it should be reversed, say so and this seat will file the revert.

Card closed as completed.
